variant: IconButton icon=drive_file_rename_outline, size xl, radius control, iconSize 17, variant onMedia; 28x28
purpose: Renames the attachment.
behaviour: Click runs rename(): askText sheet headline "Rename attachment", glyph drive_file_rename_outline, value = base name, tail = "."+extension when present, accept "Rename". Detail is "Renames the label only — the linked file is untouched." for remote attachments, otherwise "The stored file is renamed to match." An empty or unchanged name is ignored. On success it calls api.renameAttachment, then propagateAttachmentRename(task_id, old name, new name), then onRenamed. The rename UI is not shown in the recording.
look: 28x28, radius 7px, icon 17px, colour about white at 70% alpha. No fill.

behaviour: Click runs remove(): askConfirm sheet with glyph delete_forever, tone danger, headline "Remove attachment?", detail "“{attachment.name}” — attachments skip the Trash.", accept "Remove".
